description: Lint feedback after every edit and shell command, and the dmypy daemon's lifecycle (docs/features/static-analysis-20261031/spec.md, S06 and S08). Codex runs commandWindows through cmd /C, so the gate is Python started with -S rather than bash. The Windows commands assume the session starts at the repository root.

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -S scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-start; fi; exec uv run --no-project python scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-start
hooks.commandWindows: if exist .venv\Scripts\python.exe (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -S scripts\agent_lint_gate.py session-start) else (uv run --no-project python scripts\agent_lint_gate.py session-start)

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -S scripts/agent_lint_gate.py edit; fi; exec uv run --no-project python scripts/agent_lint_gate.py edit
hooks.commandWindows: if exist .venv\Scripts\python.exe (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -S scripts\agent_lint_gate.py edit) else (uv run --no-project python scripts\agent_lint_gate.py edit)

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -S scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-end; fi; exec uv run --no-project python scripts/agent_lint_gate.py session-end
hooks.commandWindows: if exist .venv\Scripts\python.exe (.venv\Scripts\python.exe -S scripts\agent_lint_gate.py session-end) else (uv run --no-project python scripts\agent_lint_gate.py session-end)
